summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing its monthly Total Voting Rights and Capital disclosure under UK Disclosure and Transparency Rule 5.6.1, dated 2 November 2026. As at 31 October 2026, issued share capital comprised 152,290,380 ordinary shares of 20 340/399 pence, with 5,431,782 held in treasury, leaving 146,858,598 total voting rights. Buybacks were made under the shareholder authority granted at the 7 May 2026 AGM and prior instructions announced 17 February 2026. This is a routine denominator notice, not a special situation; no price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock applies.
